title.narrative: Seismic Resilience and Energy Efficiency in Public Buildings Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Seismic Resilience and Energy Efficiency (EE) in Public Buildings Project for Turkey is to improve the disaster resilience and reduce energy use in selected central government buildings, and to strengthen the policy framework and institutional capacity to develop, finance, and implement resilient and sustainable public buildings in Turkey. The project comprises of three components. The first component, investments in central government buildings for structural strengthening and EE improvement. Under this component, Ministry of Environment and Urbanization (MoEU) will support the structural strengthening and renovation, or demolition and reconstruction of central government buildings (that is, public buildings under central line ministries, such as education facilities, dormitories, and hospitals, etc.). It consists of following sub-components: (i) retrofitting and renovation; and (ii) demolition and reconstruction. The second component, advanced technical assistance and capacity building supports the development of a long term and a significantly scaled-up investment program focused on increasing the EE, structural strengthening, and multi-hazard resilience of public buildings in Turkey. The third component, project management will finance project management and implementation support activities, including, inter alia, engineering, architectural, occupational health, and safety (OHS), individual consultants and other necessary technical expertise; sub-projects supervision; monitoring and evaluation of the project; communication with project beneficiaries; training of project implementation unit (PIU) staff, etc.

The proposed Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve the disaster resilience and reduce energy use in selected Central Government Buildings, and to strengthen the policy framework and institutional capacity to develop, finance and implement resilient and sustainable public buildings in Turkiye.

condition.narrative: LA, Schedule 2, Section I.A.2(b). The Borrower, through MoEU, shall, by no later than 30 days after the Effective Date, hireand/or assign to the PIU one (1) procurement specialist, one (1) financial management specialist, one (1) environmental specialist,one (1) social specialist, and one (1) occupational health and safety specialist, all with terms of reference and qualificationsacceptable to the Bank.
LA, Schedule 2, Section I.B. The Borrower, through MoEU, shall maintain throughout Project implementation, a Project OperationsManual (“POM”), in substance and manner acceptable to the Bank.

LA, Schedule 2, Section I.C. For the purposes of carrying out Part 1 of the Project, the Borrower, through MoEU, shall ensure that,unless otherwise agreed to by the Bank in writing and thereafter incorporated into the POM, each Subproject is appraised, selectedand prioritized in accordance with standards, criteria and procedures acceptable to the Bank, as specified in the Loan Agreementandfurther detailed in the POM.

LA, Schedule 2, Section I.D.1 and 2. The Borrower, through MoEU, shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordance withthe Environmental and Social Standards, and with the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan, in a manner acceptable to the Bank.

LA, Schedule 2, Section I.E.1 and 2. The Borrower, through MoEU, shall prepare and furnish to the Bank not later than June 30th ofeach year during the implementation of the Project, a proposed Annual Work Plan and Budget, afford the Bank a reasonableopportunity to exchange views on each such proposed Annual Work Plan and Budget, and shall thereafter ensure that the Project isimplemented with due diligence during said following year, in accordance with such Annual Work Plan and Budget as shall have beenapproved by the Bank.

Loan Agreement (LA), Schedule 2, Section I.A(b). The Borrower, through MoEU, shall maintain, throughout Project implementation, aProject Implementation Unit (“PIU”) under the General Directorate of Construction Affairs, with functions and responsibilitiesacceptable to the Bank, for the implementation of the Project.

actual.value: The General Directorate of Vocational Services is implementing the Project for Determining Design Calculation and Construction Principles Related to Retrofitting Methods. The regulatory proposals developed during the “Workshop on Innovative Renovation and Energy Efficiency Engineering Approaches,” held under SREPPB, were submitted to the relevant General Directorate. The DG of Construction Works will be asked for their opinion again on the draft regulation in the first quarter of 2026.

title.narrative: The KAYES and KABEV databases have been integrated to develop a comprehensive, countrywide EE and Seismic assessment tool

comment.narrative: Integration process is currently in planning process. Data harmonization between KAYES (energy performance inventory) and KABEV (seismic vulnerability database) will be initialized. The system architecture and interoperability framework are planned to be developed to enable unified EE and seismic risk assessments once completed.
